desc:
🍣 Suship — Can your crew survive the shift? 🍣
Team up with up to 4 friends to run a floating sushi restaurant on the open sea!
Hunt your own fish, slice, mince & torch them, and serve hungry customers before
the day ends. Miss the quota... and you're FIRED. 🔥

🎣 HOW TO PLAY
• Phase 1 – HUNT: dive in first-person and catch fish, lobster, even a shark!
• Phase 2 – SERVE: slice, mince and grill your catch, then plate it fast
• Work together — one slip and the whole crew loses the day

⭐ FEATURES
• 4-player co-op chaos — every shift is a new run
• 5+ ingredients that unlock as the day goes on (rare catches = big profit!)

❤️ Enjoying Suship? LIKE 👍 and FAVORITE ⭐ to help us grow, and FOLLOW for updates!
